title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named F&M spaces for studying, making, watching, performing, and informal recreation; confirm building access and event eligibility before going.

cards.title: Steinman College Center
cards.subtitle: Student gathering and campus-notice space
cards.notes: Use the centrally located displays to find campus announcements, then make this a practical meet-up point before an F&M event.
cards.short_summary: A named campus hub with publicly accessible posting and display space.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M’s campus-access policy identifies the Steinman College Center as a centralized location with publicly accessible bulletin-board and display space.
cards.source_title: Campus Access Policy | Franklin & Marshall College
cards.access_notes: Most campus buildings use controlled access; follow the College’s current access policy and posted building rules.

cards.title: Shadek-Fackenthal Library
cards.subtitle: Campus library study destination
cards.notes: Plan a reading or research session here, and check the library’s current service information before relying on a particular room or desk.
cards.short_summary: F&M’s named library space for research and quiet academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M’s campus-access policy specifically refers to publicly accessible library spaces on campus.
cards.source_title: Campus Access Policy | Franklin & Marshall College
cards.access_notes: Library areas may have varying access rules and hours; follow current library and College access guidance.

cards.title: Philadelphia Alumni Writers House
cards.subtitle: 633 College Ave. — writing and reading center
cards.notes: Watch for a reading, workshop, or other listed program, or use its campus role as a prompt to connect with F&M’s writing community.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated campus center for writers and readers.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M describes the Philadelphia Alumni Writers House at 633 College Ave. as a center of creative innovation drawing writers and readers from campus and the community.
cards.access_notes: Attend scheduled programs or confirm access with the hosting department; general campus-building access is controlled.

cards.title: Green Room Theatre
cards.subtitle: 530 College Ave. — student-performance venue
cards.notes: Look for a student production or performance listing and arrive through the event’s designated entry rather than assuming the theater is open daily.
cards.short_summary: A historic F&M theater that hosts student productions.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M states that its historic Green Room Theatre at 530 College Ave. hosts student productions.
cards.access_notes: Use only for scheduled events or with College authorization; confirm event-specific attendance requirements.

cards.title: Alumni Sports & Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: ASFC — multipurpose recreation complex
cards.notes: Build an active break around the pool, courts, track, or fitness equipment, and verify eligibility plus current facility hours before arriving.
cards.short_summary: F&M’s multipurpose athletic complex with multiple recreation options.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M describes the ASFC as a multipurpose athletic complex with an Olympic-sized pool, five courts, a weight room, cardiovascular equipment, and lower and upper tracks.
cards.access_notes: Facility use and building access are subject to current F&M eligibility rules, reservations, and posted hours.

cards.title: Mayser Gymnasium
cards.subtitle: Glenn Robinson Court — basketball venue
cards.notes: Check the athletics schedule for a home basketball date, then use the listed event details for entry, seating, and any attendance guidance.
cards.short_summary: The on-campus gymnasium where F&M basketball teams practice and play.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M says its men’s and women’s basketball teams practice and play on Glenn Robinson Court in Mayser Gymnasium.
cards.access_notes: Use scheduled-game or authorized access; confirm the current athletics schedule and venue instructions.

cards.title: Shadek Stadium
cards.subtitle: Multipurpose stadium for scheduled events
cards.notes: Choose a scheduled on-field event to see the space in use, and rely on the event listing for gate, ticket, and spectator information.
cards.short_summary: A lighted, turf multipurpose stadium on F&M’s campus.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M describes Shadek Stadium as a lighted multipurpose stadium with playing turf and seating for up to 2,500.
cards.access_notes: Attend during scheduled events or with authorization; event access and admission conditions can vary.

cards.title: Tylus Field
cards.subtitle: Field hockey and soccer venue
cards.notes: Put a field hockey or soccer match on your calendar, then check the official schedule for the current date and spectator instructions.
cards.short_summary: F&M’s primary field for field hockey and men’s and women’s soccer.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M identifies Tylus Field as the primary field for its field hockey and men’s and women’s soccer teams.
cards.access_notes: Use scheduled-event access and verify current event details before visiting.

cards.title: Sponaugle-Williamson Field
cards.subtitle: Football field and Iannicelli Track
cards.notes: Check the athletics calendar for a football or track event, and bring any needed spectator information from the official event listing.
cards.short_summary: A football-and-track facility with the eight-lane Iannicelli Track.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M says Sponaugle-Williamson Field is home to its football and track teams and includes the eight-lane William J. Iannicelli Track.
cards.access_notes: The College welcomes community members to use its outdoor track; follow posted rules and event closures.

cards.title: Brooks Tennis Center
cards.subtitle: Harrisburg Avenue — eight lighted courts
cards.notes: Coordinate a tennis session around posted court availability, and bring your own equipment unless a current College program says otherwise.
cards.short_summary: An eight-court, lighted tennis complex beside the ASFC.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M describes Brooks Tennis Center as a lighted, eight-court square adjacent to the Alumni Sports & Fitness Center on Harrisburg Avenue.
cards.access_notes: F&M welcomes community members to use the center; follow posted rules and check for team or event conflicts.
